rows.description: Whether this row is converted. Untick to skip the series.
At-a-glance state badge: ok, warning, error, skipped, non-image, or physio.
Participant this row converts under, as sub-XXX.
BIDS dataset slug. Rows with different datasets become sibling BIDS roots.
Session this row converts under, as ses-XXX. Blank when the study has no sessions.
How the data was acquired: mri, eeg, meg, pet, nirs. Not the same as the datatype.
The BIDS folder the row lands in: anat, func, dwi, fmap, eeg, meg, pet. An MRI acquisition can land in any of the first four.
BIDS suffix (T1w, bold, dwi, physio, ...).
Task entity (task-XXX) for func / eeg / meg rows.
Run index (run-N) when a series was repeated.
How sure the classifier is about the datatype and suffix, from 0 to 1.
Where the row came from: the folder inside the raw tree that holds its files.
What the row was read from: DICOM, ECAT, FIF, EDF, BrainVision, EEGLAB, CTF.
Scanner sequence name used for classification. Empty for formats that do not name one.
The BIDS filename this row will be written as, without its extension. Edit the entity columns to change it.
What the classifier recognised the sequence as: T1w, bold, dwi, fieldmap, scout. MRI only.
Converter backend that will handle the row: dcm2niix, mne-bids, ecat, or bidsphysio.
Source recording path (EEG / MEG). Blank for DICOM rows.
Number of source files in the series.
Acquisition time from the DICOM / recording header.
DICOM ImageType (ORIGINAL / DERIVED, MAGNITUDE / PHASE, ...).
Study date, used to cluster longitudinal sessions.
DICOM StudyDescription (the study / protocol name). Read-only, MRI only. Not a BIDS entity; shown for awareness. Multiple distinct values in one scan raise a warning.
DICOM PatientID, a key part of subject identity.
Patient given name from the header.
Patient family name from the header.
Participant sex (M/F/O). Seeded from the header; editable; written to participants.tsv.
Participant age in years. Seeded from the header; editable; written to participants.tsv.
Participant handedness (R/L/A). Seeded from the recording header; editable.
EEG / MEG channel count.
Sampling frequency (Hz) of the recording.
Recording duration in seconds.
Power-line frequency (Hz) written to the sidecar. Dropdown (50 / 60); blank uses the dataset default.
EEG / MEG montage applied on conversion. Dropdown of MNE built-in montages; blank leaves positions as-is.
Per-row EEG reference electrode override (e.g. Cz). Blank uses the dataset default.
Per-row EEG ground electrode override. Blank uses the dataset default.
Already-curated companion files (events / beh / stim) linked to this row and copied into BIDS on convert. Edit via the Properties panel.
NIfTI files dcm2niix actually produced in a --probe-convert run.
Volumes dcm2niix actually produced in a --probe-convert run.
Repeat classification, e.g. suspected_abort (operator restart).
Scanner-detected notes: non-image series, B0 reroute, missing entity, ...
